compiled_state.title: Implement enforcement.strategy=ci gate in review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying:
- DD2 (partial): review-gate.sh PreToolUse emits HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci when enforcement.strategy=ci is set

## Description

Add enforcement.strategy gate to plugins/dso/hooks/lib/review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh so the PreToolUse hook short-circuits (returns 0, emits HOOK_GATE: skipped) when enforcement.strategy=ci.

### Changes to review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh

After the existing `source "$_LIB_DIR/deps.sh"` line, add:
```bash
source "$_LIB_DIR/enforcement-gate.sh"
```

At the START of the `hook_review_bypass_sentinel()` function body (before the TOOL_NAME check), add:
```bash
_dso_enforcement_gate_check && return 0
```

This makes the function:
1. Check enforcement.strategy from config
2. If ci: emit HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci to stderr, return 0
3. If local or absent: continue with normal bypass pattern matching

### Why this placement

The enforcement gate MUST fire before any other logic (before TOOL_NAME check, before pattern matching). This ensures the hook is completely inert under ci strategy — it does not inspect the command at all. This matches the pre-commit hook pattern exactly (see pre-commit-review-gate.sh line 48).

### Pattern reference (from pre-commit-review-gate.sh)
```bash
# from plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-review-gate.sh:44-48
# Read enforcement.strategy from dso-config.conf and short-circuit when ci.
source "$HOOK_DIR/lib/enforcement-gate.sh"
_dso_enforcement_gate_check && exit 0
```

The same pattern applied here uses `return 0` instead of `exit 0` since this is a function, not a script entry point.

### Verification: run bypass-sentinel tests with ci config
```bash
TMPDIR_CI=$(mktemp -d /tmp/verify-ci-gate.XXXXXX)
printf 'enforcement.strategy=ci\n' > "$TMPDIR_CI/dso-config.conf"
WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$TMPDIR_CI/dso-config.conf" bash -c "
    source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh
    hook_review_bypass_sentinel '{\"tool_name\":\"Bash\",\"tool_input\":{\"command\":\"git commit --no-verify -m test\"}}'
    echo exit:\$?
" 2>&1
rm -rf "$TMPDIR_CI"
# Expected: exit:0 AND "HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=enforcement.strategy=ci" in stderr
```

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tests pass including new enforcement.strategy tests (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] enforcement-gate.sh is sourced in review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'enforcement-gate.sh' plugins/dso/hooks/lib/review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh
- [ ] _dso_enforcement_gate_check invoked at function entry in hook_review_bypass_sentinel
  Verify: grep -q '_dso_enforcement_gate_check' plugins/dso/hooks/lib/review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh
- [ ] hook_review_bypass_sentinel returns 0 when enforcement.strategy=ci
  Verify: TMPDIR_CI=$(mktemp -d /tmp/verify-ci-gate.XXXXXX); printf 'enforcement.strategy=ci\n' > "$TMPDIR_CI/dso-config.conf"; RESULT=$(WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$TMPDIR_CI/dso-config.conf" bash -c "source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh; hook_review_bypass_sentinel '{\"tool_name\":\"Bash\",\"tool_input\":{\"command\":\"git commit --no-verify -m test\"}}'; echo exit:\$?" 2>/dev/null); rm -rf "$TMPDIR_CI"; echo "$RESULT" | grep -q "exit:0"
- [ ] hook_review_bypass_sentinel still blocks --no-verify when enforcement.strategy=local
  Verify: TMPDIR_LO=$(mktemp -d /tmp/verify-local-gate.XXXXXX); printf 'enforcement.strategy=local\n' > "$TMPDIR_LO/dso-config.conf"; RESULT=$(WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$TMPDIR_LO/dso-config.conf" bash -c "source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh; hook_review_bypass_sentinel '{\"tool_name\":\"Bash\",\"tool_input\":{\"command\":\"git commit --no-verify -m test\"}}'; echo exit:\$?" 2>/dev/null); rm -rf "$TMPDIR_LO"; echo "$RESULT" | grep -q "exit:2"
